modification: Namespaced absolute imports. Added optional vae_ckpt argument for a local VAE path. VAE encoding now accepts an explicit execution_device, rejects meta input/execution, and does not move image data to vae.device (which can be meta under Accelerate offload). Standard and Pix2Pix paths pass self.device. Added optional encode/denoise/decode/safety stage callbacks for whole-model placement. UNet/VAE/safety checker select available local safetensors or .bin explicitly. Safety checker initialized to None when skipped. Runtime wrapper uses local checkpoint directories.
